executiveAssessment.text: Casas del XVI currently shows AI Consideration of 31.7% and Scenario Presence of 41.3%, with Reality Coverage at 40.0%. Strongest governed signal: Often placed near the top when AI ranks hotels. Primary constraint: AI does not fully reflect the property. Versus the prior published run (2026-09-10), material headline movement is AI Consideration 0.0 pp and Scenario Presence 0.0 pp. Independent Positioning shows #2 of 5 with Portfolio AI Presence 31.7%. Independent Positioning is weak as well, so the Core and portfolio reads point in the same direction. Overall Core performance remains weak; gaps are broad across consideration, scenario coverage, and Independent Positioning. Management should prioritize correcting clear visibility and reality gaps, then address the competitors that most often appear when the property is absent.
